what: Plan skips the existing real generator harness while changing generate-code-flow-diagram.sh argv parsing and prompt base selection
scenario_or_breakage: step-7a tests stub the generator, so a broken --base-remote parser or a prompt that still diffs origin/main can pass all proposed tests
suggested_fix: Update test-generate-code-flow-diagram.sh to invoke the real helper with default and upstream/main flags, have the launch stub capture/read --prompt-file, and assert the Changed files section reflects the selected base; update test-generate-code-flow-diagram.md

what: Fork-mode generator argv propagation is not asserted
scenario_or_breakage: The new diagram-skip-forked case intentionally skips generation, and the green assertion only proves non-fork origin/main; an implementation that always passes origin/main to the generator in fork mode would not be caught
suggested_fix: Add an assertion to the existing forked-target case, or a non-skipping fork fixture, that calls.log contains generate-code-flow-diagram.sh --base-remote upstream --base-ref main

what: New base flags are planned as loose strings with only arg-count validation
scenario_or_breakage: The plan says empty/whitespace values are rejected, but the existing fail_usage pattern only checks that a following argv token exists; malformed values can produce /main or split refs and silently fall back to HEAD~1
suggested_fix: Validate non-empty base remote/ref with the same supported-character regex used by rebase-push.sh, build a BASE_TARGET variable, and quote it in git merge-base
